red_team.interpretation: The headline is held-out incremental regional R2 over development region means. It asks whether reserve.total adds predictive information within a region after its ordinary level is known. Raw regional R2 is diagnostic because fixed region effects can otherwise dominate it. The reserve total is a checked deterministic function of already published exposure, so it supplies no world-specific information conditional on that exposure. Pooled and aggregate values are descriptive. Worlds, not regions or continuation members, are the independent units. No p-values are computed.
red_team.primary_measure: qualification incremental regional R2 over development region means
